title: Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp cycle-versus-clique Ramsey conjecture
statement:
For graphs $G$ and $H$, let $R(G,H)$ denote the least integer $N$ such that every red-blue colouring of the edges of $K_N$ contains a red copy of $G$ or a blue copy of $H$. **Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp conjecture.** If $n\geq m\geq 3$, then 
$$
R(C_n,K_m)=(n-1)(m-1)+1.
$$
 The source says this remains open, although it is known in several broad parameter ranges.
source_name: Richard Montgomery, “Recent progress in graph theory using expansion”, arXiv:2607.26049 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26049

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2026).
